title: Evidence dialog
responsibility: Displays titled evidence or text in a native modal dialog with optional footer content.

inputs.name: Modal.open
inputs.description: Optional open state, defaulting to false. Used only when isOpen is null or undefined.

inputs.name: Modal.isOpen
inputs.description: Optional open-state alias. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, using open. A supplied boolean takes precedence, including false.

inputs.name: Modal.title
inputs.description: Optional dialog heading, defaulting to an empty string.

inputs.name: Modal.variant
inputs.description: Optional presentation, defaulting to image. Text adds text styling; lightbox fills the viewport.

inputs.name: Modal.onClose
inputs.description: Optional close-request callback. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no callback). Runs first for the close button, backdrop and native cancel event; the parent owns open state.

inputs.name: Modal.onclose
inputs.description: Optional alternate close-request callback. Defaults to JavaScript undefined (no callback). Runs after onClose when supplied; a preceding throw prevents this call.

inputs.name: Modal.children
inputs.description: Optional dialog body snippet. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, rendering no body content.

inputs.name: Modal.footer
inputs.description: Optional footer snippet. Defaults to JavaScript undefined, omitting the footer.

outputs.name: Modal
outputs.description: A native dialog when isOpen, or otherwise open, is true. It shows the title, child content and optional footer in the selected image, text or lightbox presentation. Close-button and backdrop actions invoke both supplied close callbacks; Escape also invokes them through the cancel event. The parent owns the open state.

errors.name: Caller content or close callback error
errors.description: Body/footer snippet failures and errors from either supplied close callback propagate. onClose runs before onclose; a throw prevents the second callback.
